title: Mendix Developer Senior | LowCode
description:
Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior – Mendix para liderar projetos estratégicos e ser referência técnica no time. Se você tem carreira sólida em tecnologia, experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix e gosta de compartilhar conhecimento, essa oportunidade é para você!


O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações Mendix, garantindo qualidade e integração.
  • Apoiar decisões de arquitetura e orientar o time em melhores práticas.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, com foco em performance e escalabilidade.
  • Ser referência técnica, promovendo aprendizado e evolução contínua.


Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com Mendix .
  • Conhecimento em integração via APIs , modelagem de dados e versionamento (Git).
  • Experiência com Mendix Studio Pro , Developer Portal e práticas low-code.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Perfil colaborativo e capacidade de orientar equipes.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura escalável , microsserviços e mensageria.
  • Conhecimento em Docker/Kubernetes , práticas DevOps e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, Azure) e integração com serviços externos.
  • Base sólida em Java, JavaScript e princípios S.O.L.I.D.



O que oferecemos:


Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.


Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!


O time está te esperando, vamos nessa?


#VempraTQI

title: Recruiter
description:
Job Title: Recruiter

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Experience: 2–5 years


Job Description:

We are looking for a Recruiter to manage end-to-end hiring for technical and non-technical roles. The ideal candidate will have strong sourcing skills, experience working with remote teams, and a good understanding of the Brazilian talent market.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment from sourcing to offer rollout
  • Source candidates via LinkedIn, job portals, and referrals
  • Conduct initial screening and coordinate interviews
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements
  • Maintain ATS data and recruitment reports

Required Skills:

  • Experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
  • Strong sourcing and screening skills
  • Familiarity with ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Excellent communication skills (Portuguese required; English preferred)

Nice to Have:

  • Experience hiring for tech roles
  • Exposure to global or remote hiring models

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SalesForce
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Oportunidade para: Desenvolvedor(a) SalesForce Sênior


Experiência sólida (nível sênior) em projetos Salesforce, atuando como desenvolvedor(a) por no mínimo 4 anos (ou equivalente).


Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.

Experiência prática com integrações complexas e grandes volumes de dados


Desejável experiência em projetos de implementação de soluções escaláveis em empresas de médio e grande porte.

Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.


Implementar integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST/SOAP.

Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.

Otimizar queries e gerenciar limites da plataforma (governor limits).

Colaborar com times funcionais e administradores para entrega de soluções técnicas aderentes aos requisitos de negócio.

Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (DevOps), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CD.


certificações Salesforce.


Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto e CLT e PJ


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.


The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.


About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaboration


  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform )
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

title: Vendedor(a)
description:
Com foco em inovação e excelência em nossas operações, buscamos profissionais apaixonados e apaixonadas por vendas e atendimento aos clientes para se juntar à nossa equipe e desfrutar de um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, desafiador e gratificante, que proporciona grandes oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e financeiro.

Responsabilidades:

Televendas ativo de materiais elétricos, hidráulicos, itens para MRO, iluminação, automação elétrica industrial, EPI's, linha contra incêndio, entre outros, para clientes corporativos (PJ), como construtoras, incorporadoras, indústrias, engenharias, estabelecimentos comerciais, etc.

Prospecção de clientes, captação, reativação, acompanhamento e pós-venda.

Análise de mercado, da posição e das necessidades dos clientes, identificação de oportunidades de negócios;

Foco no atendimento aos clientes e na estratégia de resultados

Requisitos:

Experiência com venda ativa por telefone, prospecção e reativação de clientes, acompanhamento e pós-venda, negociação e técnicas de atendimento e vendas à clientes corporativos.

Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de persuasão e negociação estratégica;

Boa capacidade de organização, de atenção e proatividade;

Foco no cliente


Remuneração atrativa composta por salário fixo + comissionamento + premiação + VT + VR/VA + Assist. Médica + Assist. Odontológica + Seguro de Vida + Auxílio-Educação


Trabalho presencial (Porto Alegre), de segunda a sexta, horário comercial.

title: Científico de datos
description:
We’re Hiring | Data Scientist (Remote – Full Time)

Staffing Abroad is currently looking for a Data Scientist for one of our U.S.-based clients in the digital assets and FinTech space. In this role, you’ll transform complex datasets into predictive insights that drive strategy, growth, and performance across Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Operations.


What you’ll do:

  • Build and deploy machine learning and predictive models for revenue forecasting and business optimization
  • Perform statistical analysis, feature engineering, and A/B testing
  • Develop dashboards and insights using Domo for executive decision-making
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Finance, and Marketing teams
  • Explore and prototype AI/ML innovations, including LLMs and generative AI.


Tech Stack:

Snowflake must | Rivery | dbt | Domo or similar | Python expert level | SQL expert level


What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning
  • Strong skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred)
  • Background in FinTech, SaaS, or data-driven environments is a plus
  • Strong business mindset and data storytelling skills
  • Advanced English level (C1) required


Why apply?

  • 100% remote role
  • Competitive compensation with bonus eligibility
  • High-impact, data-driven projects
  • Collaborative and fast-paced work environment
  • Payment in USD


Interested or know someone who might be a great fit?

Feel free to apply or reach out directly.

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Groovy Pleno
description:
Estamos procurando por alguém que goste de trabalhar com tecnologia, tenham facilidade em aprender e que tenha experiência sólida em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.

Se você é esse tipo desenvolvedor, queremos te conhecer!

Somos um lugar de inovação, por isso é muito importante ter em nosso time pessoas que gostem de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento.


Vem crescer com a gente!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como desenvolvedor Pleno você será responsável pelo:

* Desenvolvimento de componentes e páginas para os nossos produtos;

* Desenvolvimento de API's Restful;

* Revisão e garantia de qualidade de código e padrões da equipe de desenvolvimento;

* Criação de queries e scripts SQL;

* Desenvolvimento backend, front-end e testes unitários;

* Discussão em propostas de solução;

* Trabalhar em ambiente Linux para desenvolvimento;

* Vivência em práticas, técnicas e metodologias ágeis;

* Realizar versionamento de código com Git;

* Quando necessário, participar também de reuniões com stakeholders para levantamento de requisitos;

* Realizar apresentações de evolução e resultados para outros desenvolvedores e demais integrantes da equipe.


Requisitos e qualificações

Os requisitos abaixo são muito importantes para atuação como Desenvolvedor em nossos times.

* Saber analisar e resolver problemas;

* Ter boa lógica de programação;

* Dominar estrutura de dados e algoritmos;

* Conhecimento em HTML, CSS, JavaScript;

* Conhecimento de Design System e componentes reutilizáveis;

* Domínio de alguma linguagem orientada a objetos, preferencialmente Java ou Groovy;

* Saber fazer consultas complexas em Bancos de dados Relacional (SGBD);

Conhecimentos desejáveis, mas não eliminatórios

* Algum framework de backend (Grails, Spring ou Spring Boot, Hibernate, Micronaut, etc.);

* TypeScript;

* Elastic Stack - ElasticSearch/Kibana;

* Continuous Integration (CI);

* Container (Docker, kubernetes, etc.);

* Arquitetura orientada a serviços;

* Mensageria e Stream de dados (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.);

* Boas práticas de desenvolvimento como TDD e Design Patterns;


Informações adicionais

* Cartão flexível de Vale Alimentação e Refeição;

* Vale Transporte;

* Plano de Saúde;

* Plano Odontológico;

* Auxílio Home office

* Ginastica Laboral;

* Day off aniversário;

* Wellnes hub;

* Acesso à plataforma Zenklub, uma rede com mais de 150 especialistas em saúde mental;

* Convênio com Instituições de Ensino: IPOG e WiseUp;

* Eventos de Integração (Meetups, Workshop, Maratonas e Festas);

* Aprendizado Constante somado a Oportunidade de crescimento;

* Ótimo ambiente de trabalho.


Nossas equipes possuem autonomia para correr atrás de seus resultados.


Tecnologia e Inovação fazem parte da nossa essência.

title: Head Comercial
description:
Quem Somos

A PayConductor.AI está construindo a plataforma de orquestração de pagamentos mais inteligente do mundo. Não somos apenas mais uma fintech, estamos desenvolvendo uma frota de agentes de IA especializados que otimizam rotas de pagamento, reduzem custos e transformam dados financeiros complexos em insights acionáveis em tempo real.

Acreditamos que pagamentos devem ser inteligentes, fluidos e auto-otimizáveis. Nosso time é enxuto, rápido e obcecado em construir tecnologia que realmente funciona.

Se você quer fazer parte de algo que ainda não existe em nenhum outro lugar, seja bem-vindo.


Descrição

Temos o produto mais inovador do mercado de pagamentos. Agora precisamos de alguém que faça o mercado saber disso.

Você vai construir a máquina de vendas da PayConductor do zero. Não é sobre seguir um playbook, é sobre escrever o playbook. Definir processos, montar time, criar materiais, fechar os primeiros grandes clientes, e escalar a operação.

Se você já vendeu SaaS B2B, entende o ciclo de vendas consultivas, e sente aquele brilho no olho quando fecha um deal complexo, queremos conversar. Se além disso você entende de pagamentos ou fintech, melhor ainda. Se não entende, vai aprender rápido, porque nosso produto praticamente se vende sozinho quando explicado direito.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir estratégia comercial, metas e processos de vendas.
  • Montar e liderar o time comercial (AEs e SDRs).

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Quem Somos

A PayConductor.AI está construindo a plataforma de orquestração de pagamentos mais inteligente do mundo. Não somos apenas mais uma fintech, estamos desenvolvendo uma frota de agentes de IA especializados que otimizam rotas de pagamento, reduzem custos e transformam dados financeiros complexos em insights acionáveis em tempo real.

Acreditamos que pagamentos devem ser inteligentes, fluidos e auto-otimizáveis. Nosso time é enxuto, rápido e obcecado em construir tecnologia que realmente funciona.

Se você quer fazer parte de algo que ainda não existe em nenhum outro lugar, seja bem-vindo.


Descrição

Pagamentos são chatos. Todo mundo sabe disso. Taxas, relatórios, conciliação, a maioria das plataformas do mercado parece ter sido desenhada para punir o usuário.

Seu trabalho é mudar isso.

Na PayConductor, queremos que gerenciar pagamentos seja tão intuitivo quanto pedir comida por aplicativo. Queremos que um CFO olhe pro dashboard e entenda instantaneamente onde está economizando. Queremos que conversar com nossos agentes de IA seja natural, quase humano, só que mais útil.

Se você acredita que bom design é invisível, que cada pixel tem propósito, e que UX em fintech não precisa ser sinônimo de sofrimento, sua missão começa aqui.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar a experiência completa da plataforma PayConductor, do onboarding ao uso diário.
  • Criar interfaces para o Concierge.AI que tornem a interação com IA natural e poderosa.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e visualizações de dados que transformem complexidade em clareza.
  • Conduzir pesquisas com usuários para validar decisões de design.
  • Criar e manter design system escalável.
  • Colaborar com engenharia para garantir que o que foi desenhado seja o que foi construído.
  • Prototipar rapidamente para testar hipóteses antes de comprometer código.


Qualificações

  • Portfólio demonstrando experiência em design de produtos digitais complexos.
  • Domínio de Figma (ou ferramenta equivalente).
  • Experiência com design de dashboards e visualização de dados.
  • Conhecimento de princípios de UX writing, as palavras importam tanto quanto os pixels.
  • Capacidade de defender suas decisões de design com argumentos racionais, não só \"achismos\".
  • Familiaridade com design systems e componentes reutilizáveis.
  • Sensibilidade para acessibilidade e design inclusivo.
  • Diferenciais: experiência com produtos B2B/SaaS, familiaridade com interfaces conversacionais, conhecimento básico de front-end.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Quem Somos

A PayConductor.AI está construindo a plataforma de orquestração de pagamentos mais inteligente do mundo. Não somos apenas mais uma fintech, estamos desenvolvendo uma frota de agentes de IA especializados que otimizam rotas de pagamento, reduzem custos e transformam dados financeiros complexos em insights acionáveis em tempo real.

Acreditamos que pagamentos devem ser inteligentes, fluidos e auto-otimizáveis. Nosso time é enxuto, rápido e obcecado em construir tecnologia que realmente funciona.

Se você quer fazer parte de algo que ainda não existe em nenhum outro lugar, seja bem-vindo.


Descrição

Vender é só o começo. Seu trabalho é garantir que o cliente extraia tanto valor da PayConductor que a ideia de cancelar nunca passe pela cabeça dele.

Você vai ser consultor, advogado do cliente internamente, e às vezes terapeuta. Vai entender o negócio de cada cliente profundamente, garantir que eles usem a plataforma da melhor forma possível, e identificar oportunidades de expandir a conta.

Na PayConductor, CS não é suporte glorificado. É estratégico. Você vai trabalhar com dados de uso, métricas de valor entregue, e ter conversas de negócio com diretores e C-levels.

Se você genuinamente se importa com o sucesso dos outros e consegue equilibrar empatia com visão de negócio, esse é seu lugar.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir onboarding de novos clientes, garantindo ativação rápida e correta.
  • Monitorar health score e indicadores de engajamento de cada conta.
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas de acompanhamento (QBRs) com clientes estratégicos.
  • Identificar riscos de churn e agir proativamente para reverter.
  • Identificar oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell, trabalhando com comercial.
  • Ser a voz do cliente internamente, trazer feedback para produto, engenharia e liderança.
  • Construir relacionamentos de confiança de longo prazo.


Qualificações

  • Experiência em Customer Success, Account Management ou função similar em SaaS B2B.
  • Capacidade de entender métricas de negócio e traduzir uso de produto em valor tangível.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de construir relacionamentos.
  • Proatividade, você não espera o cliente reclamar pra agir.
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplas contas simultaneamente.
  • Conforto com dados e ferramentas de CS (Gainsight, Totango, ou similares).
  • Diferenciais: experiência em fintech/pagamentos, background técnico, experiência com clientes enterprise.

title: Content Operations Manager
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support 1,000+ providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.



What You Will Do



Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings



Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A PayConductor.AI está construindo a plataforma de orquestração de pagamentos mais inteligente do mundo. Não somos apenas mais uma fintech, estamos desenvolvendo uma frota de agentes de IA especializados que otimizam rotas de pagamento, reduzem custos e transformam dados financeiros complexos em insights acionáveis em tempo real.

Acreditamos que pagamentos devem ser inteligentes, fluidos e auto-otimizáveis. Nosso time é enxuto, rápido e obcecado em construir tecnologia que realmente funciona.

Se você quer fazer parte de algo que ainda não existe em nenhum outro lugar, seja bem-vindo.


Descrição

Números contam histórias. Às vezes histórias de sucesso, às vezes histórias de terror. Seu trabalho é descobrir qual é qual antes que o cliente descubra sozinho.

Na PayConductor, você vai ser a ponte entre os dados brutos e as decisões estratégicas. Vai criar dashboards que fazem executivos terem insights no café da manhã, relatórios que provam o ROI dos nossos agentes de IA, e análises que revelam oportunidades escondidas nos padrões de pagamento.

Se você consegue olhar para uma planilha e ver a Matrix, se um gráfico bem feito te dá satisfação pessoal, e se você acredita que dados sem contexto são apenas números aleatórios, essa vaga foi feita pra você.


Responsabilidades

  • Criar e manter dashboards executivos que mostram a performance da plataforma e dos agentes de IA.
  • Desenvolver relatórios de valor para clientes, mostrando economia gerada, otimizações realizadas e oportunidades identificadas.
  • Analisar padrões transacionais para identificar insights acionáveis.
  • Definir e monitorar KPIs de produto e negócio.
  • Traduzir perguntas de negócio em análises de dados (e traduzir análises de dados em respostas que humanos entendem).
  • Colaborar com times de produto, comercial e CS para fornecer inteligência baseada em dados.


Qualificações

  • Domínio de SQL e ferramentas de BI (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experiência com análise exploratória de dados e storytelling com dados.
  • Conhecimento em Python para análises mais complexas é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de entender o contexto de negócio por trás dos números.
  • Habilidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não-técnicos.
  • Olho crítico para identificar anomalias, tendências e oportunidades.
  • Diferenciais: experiência com métricas de SaaS, conhecimento do mercado de pagamentos, familiaridade com análise de cohorts e funis.

title: Data Analyst
description:
To work in 6 months remote Project we are looking for a bilingual Data Analyst


The ideal candidate will use their passion for data analytics to provide insights to the business covering a range of topics. They will be responsible for conducting both recurring and ad hoc analysis for business users.

  • Understand the day-to-day issues that our business faces, which can be better understood with data

  • Proficient in SQL
  • Proficent in Python
  • Able to work on assigned data with minimal daily input from client
  • Manipulate raw data sources to generate business insights, ideally that can be turned to predictive AI in a later project.

Você vai vender o futuro dos pagamentos. Literalmente.

Enquanto a concorrência ainda está tentando explicar o que faz, você vai demonstrar agentes de IA que otimizam rotas em tempo real, reduzem custos automaticamente, e dão insights que antes precisavam de um time inteiro de analistas.

Não é uma venda fácil, é uma venda técnica, consultiva, que exige entender o problema do cliente às vezes melhor que ele mesmo. Mas quando você fecha, fecha grande. E o cliente agradece porque você genuinamente resolveu um problema que tirava o sono dele.

Se você é do tipo que estuda o cliente antes da call, que faz perguntas que fazem o prospect pensar, e que constrói relacionamentos de longo prazo, essa é sua arena.

  • Conduzir todo o ciclo de vendas, do primeiro contato ao fechamento.

  • Manter pipeline atualizado e forecast preciso no CRM.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com decisores e influenciadores nas contas-alvo.
  • Colaborar com SDRs na qualificação de leads e com CS na transição pós-venda.
  • Trazer feedback do mercado para times de produto e marketing.

  • Experiência em vendas B2B SaaS com ciclo de vendas médio/longo.
  • Habilidade demonstrada em vendas consultivas e técnicas.
  • Capacidade de conduzir demos de produto de forma clara e persuasiva.
  • Organização impecável, você não perde follow-up e não deixa deal esfriar.

  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Job Title: Technical Recruiter

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract/ Full Time


Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Technical Recruiter based in Brazil to support end-to-end recruitment for technology roles across engineering, data, cloud, and emerging tech domains. This is a fully remote position, where you will collaborate with global hiring managers to attract, evaluate, and hire top technical talent.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and onboarding support
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand technical requirements and hiring priorities
  • Source candidates using multiple channels, including LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and technical communities
  • Screen resumes and conduct initial technical and behavioral interviews
  • Coordinate and schedule interviews with candidates and interview panels
  • Maintain accurate candidate records in ATS and ensure recruitment metrics are tracked
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of technical talent for current and future needs
  • Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process
  • Support employer branding initiatives and recruitment marketing activities
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A PayConductor.AI está construindo a plataforma de orquestração de pagamentos mais inteligente do mundo. Não somos apenas mais uma fintech, estamos desenvolvendo uma frota de agentes de IA especializados que otimizam rotas de pagamento, reduzem custos e transformam dados financeiros complexos em insights acionáveis em tempo real.

Acreditamos que pagamentos devem ser inteligentes, fluidos e auto-otimizáveis. Nosso time é enxuto, rápido e obcecado em construir tecnologia que realmente funciona.

Se você quer fazer parte de algo que ainda não existe em nenhum outro lugar, seja bem-vindo.


Descrição

Dados são o novo petróleo. Só que petróleo não precisa ser limpo, transformado, versionado e disponibilizado em tempo real para uma frota de agentes de IA famintos por informação. Dados precisam. E é aí que você entra.

Na PayConductor, estamos construindo a infraestrutura de dados que vai alimentar a próxima geração de inteligência em pagamentos. Não estamos falando de dashboardzinhos bonitos, estamos falando de pipelines robustos que ingerem dados de adquirentes, bandeiras, Banco Central, e transformam tudo isso em combustível para IAs que tomam decisões em milissegundos.

Se você acha que um pipeline bem arquitetado é uma obra de arte, que data quality é questão de honra, e que \"funciona na minha máquina\" não é resposta aceitável, vem com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados escaláveis para ingestão de múltiplas fontes (APIs de adquirentes, arquivos de bandeiras, dados regulatórios).
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e governança dos dados que alimentam os agentes de IA.
  • Construir data lakes e data warehouses que façam sentido (não aquele cemitério de tabelas que ninguém entende).
  • Implementar processos de ETL/ELT eficientes e monitoráveis.
  • Colaborar com o time de ML para garantir que os dados estejam no formato certo, na hora certa, no lugar certo.
  • Documentar schemas, linhagem de dados e processos como se o próximo engenheiro fosse um serial killer que sabe seu endereço.


Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com Python e SQL (SQL de verdade, não só SELECT *).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e seus serviços de dados.
  • Familiaridade com bancos relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Entendimento de princípios de data quality e data governance.
  • Capacidade de debugar um pipeline às 23h sem chorar (muito).
  • Diferenciais: experiência com dados financeiros/transacionais, conhecimento de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis), familiaridade com o ecossistema de pagamentos mundial.

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of Information & Communication Engineering
description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.


WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of Clinical Medicine
description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.


WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

ABAP, Fiori

title: Consultor de Infraestrutura Sênior
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Infraestrutura  para atuar em um projeto global, com foco no mapeamento do ambiente atual e na definição de Golden Images corporativas  para workstations e servidores, tanto em ambientes on-premises quanto cloud . 


Esse profissional terá papel estratégico na padronização de sistemas, fortalecimento da segurança, governança e sustentação da operação em escala global. 


Responsabilidades:   

  • Mapear os sistemas operacionais de workstations e servidores  em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo visibilidade completa do cenário atual. 
  • Definir padrões globais de Golden Images  para workstations e servidores, considerando diferentes sistemas operacionais e necessidades regionais. 
  • Construir e documentar políticas, padrões e definições de segurança e infraestrutura , alinhadas a boas práticas e frameworks reconhecidos. 
  • Estruturar, detalhar e executar o plano de implementação  das Golden Images, acompanhando a execução junto às equipes técnicas. 
  • Definir um modelo de controles, governança e auditoria , assegurando aderência, rastreabilidade e manutenção dos padrões ao longo do tempo. 
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes globais, apoiando decisões técnicas e conduzindo alinhamentos em ambientes diversos. 

Requisitos obrigatórios:  

  • Consultor(a) de Infraestrutura , com experiência em padronização de ambientes, imagens corporativas e frameworks de segurança . 
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura e segurança de endpoints , incluindo hardening, baseline e controles de acesso. 
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos , com foco em execução, prazos e qualidade das entregas. 
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão , comunicação clara e gestão de conflitos  com equipes técnicas e stakeholders diversos. 
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de Endpoint Management , como Tanium e Microsoft Intune , será considerado um diferencial. 
  • Inglês fluente é obrigatório , para atuação em contexto global.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About the Role:

We’re hiring a Business Analyst to manage and mentor a team of analysts creating business-focused content to improve AI models. You’ll combine leadership, quality oversight, and subject expertise in MBA-relevant domains to ensure outputs are accurate, logically sound, and aligned with project goals. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys people management, operational excellence, and shaping high-quality analytical content. No prior AI experience is required for this role.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts/Content Specialists.
  • Allocate tasks, oversee workflows, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Conduct QA reviews, refine processes, and improve team efficiency.
  • Provide performance feedback, training, and career development.
  • Act as the primary stakeholder contact, sharing regular project updates.
  • Guide creation of case studies, scenarios, and structured business content (finance, policy, e-commerce, etc.).


What We’re Looking For:

  • 2+ years of team management experience.
  • 3–6 years in business analysis, consulting, content, or domain-focused projects.
  • Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No prior AI experience is required
  • Bonus: prior work on LLM performance data, case study writing, or academic/research content.
  • Full-time commitment (40 hrs/week); immediate joiners preferred.


Why Join Us:

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Lead a team working on cutting-edge AI projects.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

The successful candidate in this role must know that this is not a traditional 9 am to 5 pm job– evening and weekend work are required, and 40-60 hours per week are required.

You’ll work closely with our Senior Refund Coordinator and Customer Success Manager to collect data through text, phone calls, and email communication to process refunds accurately and efficiently.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm the status of selling their home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to determine if they own the home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm if a mobile home for sale does/does not come with the land it sits on.
  • Move all prospects to the proper pipeline stage via CRM throughout the day.
  • Maintain a clear, up-to-date, and accurate pipeline in our CRM.
  • Follow up diligently and consistently with sellers over extended periods.
  • Document all interactions with prospects and clients in the CRM's “notes” section, escalating to Support or the Senior Refunds Coordinator as needed.
  • Process refunds with integrity, according to the refund policy.
RESULTS
  • Reach sellers promptly to help determine the outcome of declining/approving a refund request.
  • All sellers are promptly followed up with.
  • There is an effective line of communication between this role and the Senior Refunds Coordinator in which all necessary information is communicated promptly.
  • Continuously improve communication skills (Crucial Conversations book, etc.)
  • All internal communication cycles are adequately followed.
REQUIREMENTS
  • Proven work experience with cold calling or phone sales.
  • Proven work experience with text messaging/emailing in English.
  • You must enjoy being on the phone and speaking to sellers.
  • Excellent communication skills, including listening and facing conflict head-on.
  • Excellent at building rapport.
  • Willing to work in a fast-paced environment and rapidly grow.
  • Open to learning new processes in cold calling/seller outreach.
  • Self-sufficient and able to properly manage one’s own time.
  • Well-organized and able to maintain a pipeline that the Refunds Coordinator and sales Manager can observe and understand.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Experience as a real estate investor is preferred but optional.
  • Must pass written and verbal exams.

title: Remote Content Writer
description:
About the Role:

We’re looking for a Content Writer to craft high-quality business and strategy questions, case studies, and structured content across diverse management domains with No prior AI experience required . This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical skills, excellent written English, and an MBA/business background who enjoys turning complex ideas into clear, engaging content


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop business/strategy questions in finance, public policy, e-commerce, sports analytics, etc.
  • Create case studies and real-world scenarios for MBA-level learners.
  • Organize content using structured formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • Ensure clarity, accuracy, and professionalism in all outputs.
  • Collaborate with experts to align content with real-world applications.


What We’re Looking For:

  • MBA or bachelor’s from a Tier-1/2 institute in business, economics, commerce, or management.
  • 1–5 years’ experience in content, consulting, research, or analysis.
  • Strong logical/analytical thinking and excellent written English.
  • Familiarity with structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No prior AI experience is required
  • Bonus: prior experience in case study writing or academic/business content.


Why Join Us:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Flexible, remote-first environment.
  • Competitive pay with potential contract extensions.
  • Freelance perks: exposure to advanced AI, flexible hours, global collaboration.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Developer (Palantir/PySpark) , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

● English fluently

Palantir Foundry, Typescript, React JS, Workshop, Pyspark

· • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications

Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.

  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications
  • Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
  • Improve application User Interface and visualization design
  • Implement operational applications using Foundry Tools (Workshop, Quiver, and Slate).
  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Develop writeback functionality into the tool as needed.
  • Implement data visualizations using Foundry Tools (Quiver and Contour) and/or Power BI.
  • Maintain applications as usage grows and requirements change.
  • Develop data pipelines using PySpark to create datasets, Foundry objects, and User Interface applications.
  • Collaborate with the Data Engineering Team to understand the ontology and data pipelines supporting the applications.
  • Support end-to-end data pipeline development using Python and PySpark for ETL processes.
  • Support designing and building high-scale data-intensive workflows.
  • Perform data validations and analysis, using PyTest to create and implement unit tests.
  • Implement Foundry Expectations within Foundry Health checks for automated validations.
  • Monitor and debug critical issues such as data staleness or data quality.
  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality.
  • Debug and resolve issues reported by users or identified through testing
  • Palantir

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability


For more information, write to

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label SaaS architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Designer digital
description:
A Minha Biblioteca Católica está expandindo sua atuação para o mercado americano com o lançamento do My Catholic Library, clube de assinatura católico nos Estados Unidos.


Para essa nova fase, estamos formando um time dedicado integralmente ao projeto, com profissionais criativos, estratégicos e atentos a detalhes.


O(a) Designer será responsável por criar peças visuais para Instagram, anúncios, e e-mails, garantindo consistência estética, clareza de mensagem e alto padrão visual. Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na construção da identidade da marca e na geração de desejo e conversão no mercado americano.


Se você tem olhar estético apurado, domínio técnico e entende o design como ferramenta estratégica de marca e performance, essa vaga é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:
  • Criar peças de design para Instagram (feed, stories, reels e destaques), alinhadas à estratégia de conteúdo e lançamentos;
  • Desenvolver layouts para anúncios pagos, respeitando formatos e boas práticas de performance;
  • Criar materiais visuais para e-mail marketing;
  • Garantir consistência visual a partir do posicionamento, identidade e diretrizes da marca;
  • Trabalhar a hierarquia visual, tipografia, cores e composição para clareza e conversão;
  • Adaptar peças para diferentes formatos, plataformas e proporções;
  • Interpretar e executar briefings estratégicos, propondo soluções visuais criativas;
  • Realizar ajustes e refinamentos a partir de feedbacks do time;
  • Organizar arquivos, versões e entregas dentro dos prazos definidos;
  • Acompanhar tendências de design digital, especialmente no mercado americano.


Conhecimentos e habilidades:
  • Experiência comprovada como designer gráfico ou digital para marketing e redes sociais;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design (Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign ou similares);
  • Experiência com design para redes sociais, anúncios e páginas digitais;
  • Capacidade de transformar conceitos estratégicos em peças visuais claras e atraentes;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e comprometimento com prazos;
  • Abertura para feedbacks e ajustes contínuos;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (para compreensão de briefings e referências internacionais).

title: CRO, UX Product Specialist (Onboarding, Content) | Remote, Part-time 20-30 hrs
description:
To Apply

Please complete this form:


LOCATION

Remote — Western Europe, Latin America (Argentina, Brasil/Brazil, Uruguay, Chile, Colombia)


About FullSession

FullSession is a user behavior analytics platform that helps teams understand how people really use their product or website, remove UX friction, and prove the impact of changes on activation, conversion, and revenue. Our customers span SaaS , Ecommerce/DTC , and Enterprise customer portals (finance, insurance, travel, etc.).

We’re building toward a world where teams go from seeing what happened → knowing what to fix next → validating lift.


The Role

We’re looking for a hybrid Product + CRO/UX Specialist who can wear three hats:

  • Customer onboarding & demo specialist: help prospects/customers get to “first value” fast (this is not a sales role)
  • CRO expert : diagnose funnel friction, propose experiments, and validate impact
  • Content contributor : turn real work into practical writing (CRO/UX playbooks, teardown-style posts, case studies)

This is a hands-on role. You’ll be in the product, in real customer journeys, and in front of customers.


What You’ll Do

CRO / UX & Experimentation:

  • Audit key journeys (signup → activation, onboarding, checkout, forms, critical flows) using session replay, heatmaps, funnels, and feedback.
  • Identify friction, quantify opportunity size, and prioritize a clear backlog of improvements.
  • Propose experiments and UX changes with strong hypotheses, expected impact, and success metrics.
  • Partner with product/engineering to specify changes (flow, copy, layout, instrumentation) and ensure tracking is correct.
  • Help validate lift (conversion, activation, completion, revenue per visitor, drop-off reduction) and document learnings.

Customer Onboarding & Demos (CS, not sales):

  • Run onboarding calls and product walkthroughs; help teams install/implement and reach “first insights” quickly.
  • Translate customer goals into a simple measurement plan (events/funnels) and a short list of “what to fix first.”
  • Collect structured feedback from calls and turn it into actionable product recommendations.

Writing & Thought Leadership (CRO/UX)

  • Co-create short, high-signal content with us: blog posts, case studies, teardown-style insights, and playbooks.
  • Share best practices for CRO, UX, and experimentation across SaaS, Ecommerce, and high-stakes portals.
  • Optionally publish under your name (with transparency/disclosure where relevant).


What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

  • Customers reach “first value” faster (clearer onboarding, faster first insights, fewer setup blockers).
  • A repeatable onboarding playbook (talk tracks, checklists, templates).
  • A prioritized list of product + UX improvements informed by real data and real calls.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in CRO/UX optimization and/or Product Management for a live website/web app (B2B SaaS and/or Ecommerce).
  • Strong experimentation skills: hypothesis design, metrics, A/B testing fundamentals, interpreting results.
  • Strong analytics + behavior tooling experience (GA4 and a replay/heatmap/funnel tool such as FullSession, Hotjar, etc.).
  • Comfortable moving between quantitative and qualitative signals (funnels/events + replays/feedback).
  • Strong written English: you can explain what you found, what you changed, and why it mattered.
  • High ownership: you work independently, communicate clearly async, and ship work without heavy supervision.


Nice to have

  • Experience with onboarding/implementation for analytics tools (tagging, events, confirmation that data is flowing).
  • Familiarity with privacy considerations (masking, PII, consent, compliance).
  • Experience writing for Product/Growth audiences (LinkedIn, Medium, blog).


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote-friendly engagement (start part-time 20+ hours; option to expand).
  • Fair compensation at $23/hr -- FT equivalent (173.3 hrs) = $3,986
  • Work on meaningful CRO/UX problems with modern behavior analytics tooling.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and real customer journeys.
  • Opportunities to build your public portfolio via co-authored content.


To Apply

title: Editor de vídeo
description:
A Minha Biblioteca Católica está expandindo sua atuação para o mercado americano com o lançamento do My Catholic Library, clube de assinatura católico nos Estados Unidos.


Para essa nova fase, estamos formando um time dedicado integralmente ao projeto, com profissionais criativos, técnicos e orientados à qualidade e resultado.


O(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo será responsável por editar vídeos para Instagram e anúncios, garantindo que cada peça traduza a identidade da marca, gere impacto visual e contribua para engajamento e conversão. Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na construção da percepção de valor do produto e da marca no mercado americano.


Se você tem olhar estético apurado, ritmo, domínio técnico e entende o vídeo como ferramenta estratégica de marketing, essa vaga é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:
  • Gravar e editar vídeos para Instagram (Reels, Stories e Feed), alinhados à estratégia de conteúdo e lançamentos;
  • Produzir versões de vídeos para anúncios pagos, respeitando formatos, durações e boas práticas de performance;
  • Editar vídeos para páginas de lançamento e vendas, garantindo clareza, narrativa e fluidez;
  • Aplicar cortes, ritmo, legendas, animações simples, trilhas e efeitos, mantendo alto padrão de qualidade;
  • Garantir consistência visual e narrativa com o posicionamento e identidade do My Catholic Library;
  • Ajustar vídeos com base em feedbacks estratégicos e de performance;
  • Acompanhar tendências de edição, formatos e linguagem audiovisual, especialmente no mercado americano.


Conhecimentos e habilidades:
  • Experiência comprovada como Editor(a) de Vídeo para redes sociais e marketing digital;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de edição (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut ou similares);
  • Habilidade com edição dinâmica para formatos curtos, especialmente Reels e anúncios;
  • Conhecimento de legendagem, ritmo, storytelling visual e retenção de atenção;
  • Capacidade de interpretar briefings estratégicos e transformar em vídeos eficazes;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e compromisso com prazos;
  • Mentalidade aberta a testes, ajustes e otimizações contínuas;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (para compreensão de briefings e referências internacionais).
